note: Washburn County Forestry campground on 16-acre Sawmill Lake, about 8 miles north of Birchwood in a non-motorized county forest unit reached by gravel fire lanes. Beach, fishing dock, pavilion and boat launch; a canoe portage trail links six undeveloped lakes. No ATVs/UTVs. --Claude
summary: County reservation site, per-site pages, 2025 rules and campground map read: 25 non-electric sites, hand pumps + pit toilets, $10/unit, season May 1 - Nov 30, all sites reserve-only online (same day OK, 335-day window, 1-night min, 14-night max). Lakeview KEPT: the county tags 23-25 as waterfront but they sit under continuous canopy. Old note's 'FCFS off-season' contradicted by the rules.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. The county's site pages tag sites 23, 24 and 25 'Water Front Site: Yes' (all others No); on the map they sit on a short north spur by the lake's northeast bay (around 45.7552,-91.5536). On Esri z19 and NAIP that whole shore is under continuous forest canopy with no open pad or clearing at the waterline, so lakefront is not earned on open ground; the three sites are sold by the night. Sawmill Lake is 16 acres (county), so not a pond.
BOOKING: old note said 'Reservable online May-Sep, FCFS off-season'; the 2025 rules say all sites must be reserved and paid online before occupying (same-day allowed), so fcfs never.

PHONE: stored 715-635-4490 (Washburn County Forestry, Spooner, M-F) confirmed - keep. The map adds a summer park phone 715-466-2822 (Memorial Day - Labor Day; the Totogatic Park number) and 'No Phone on Site'.
PIN: 45.7540,-91.5533 sits inside the loop between the entrance road and the lake; fine.
GOOGLE: 'Washburn County Sawmill Park Campground' 5.0 from 3 reviews (point 45.7538,-91.5534, phone 715-466-2822). Local operator, no price gate.
